definition_policy: Shared full-curve goodness metric over declared observed radial grid; exact statistic to be frozen before scoring
Inner/rising-zone diagnostic must be declared before scoring; zone boundaries source-side or catalogue-side only
Flat/outer-zone diagnostic must be declared before scoring; no post-hoc radial slicing
Held-out score must be computed after train choices freeze; no family-specific held-out relabeling
Model-family complexity penalty must count free endpoint parameters and source-side tuning privileges
Wrong-family, shuffled-label, null-source, and leakage controls must affect verdict eligibility
